attaching-a-rope-to-the-hole.text: If the player does not have any rope in their inventory:

steps.text: There is a sheer drop below the hole. You'll need a rope to get down there.

attaching-a-rope-to-the-hole.text: If the player has rope in their inventory:

steps.prompt: Attach a rope to the top of the hole?

steps.text: You tie the rope to the top of the hole and throw it down.
